texts.zh:
终于，星海参议院投票通过授予[custodian.GetName]紧急监管权。在一个向全星系广播的官方典礼上，我们被任命为星海共同体监管人。

作为同侪之首，我们负责保卫星海共同体的安全，抵御一切来自内部或外部的潜在威胁。我们在整个共同体的各项事务上被赋予了极大的权力，并且可以提出特殊的议案。
texts.en:
At last, the Galactic Senate has voted to bestow emergency Custodianship powers upon the [custodian.GetName]. In an official ceremony broadcast across the galaxy, we were appointed Custodians of the Galactic Community.

As the first among equals, we have been charged with safeguarding the Galactic Community from all potential threats, be they internal or external, who would seek it harm. We have been granted vast powers in all Community matters and can now propose special resolutions.

texts.zh:
星海参议院投票通过授予[custodian.GetName]紧急监管权。在一个向全星系广播的官方典礼上，他们被任命为星海共同体监管人。

作为同侪之首，[custodian.GetSpeciesName]政府负责保卫星海共同体的安全，抵御一切来自内部或外部的潜在威胁。他们在整个共同体的各项事务上被赋予了极大的权力，并且可以提出特殊的议案。
texts.en:
The Galactic Senate has voted to bestow emergency Custodianship powers upon the [custodian.GetName]. In a ceremony broadcast across the galaxy, they were appointed the official Custodians of the Galactic Community.

As the first among equals, the [custodian.GetSpeciesName] government is now charged with safeguarding the Galactic Community from all potential threats, be they internal or external, who would seek it harm. They have been granted vast powers in all Community matters and can now propose special resolutions.

label.zh: 现在我们可以大有作为了。
label.en: Now we can get things done.

tooltips.en: The [custodian.GetName] are now Custodians of the Galactic Community.

label.zh: 让我们看看这样会如何。
label.en: We shall see how this works out.

texts.zh: 我们作为星海共同体监管人的任期已经结束。监管人职能终止，我们的特殊权力也解除了，当然我们依然还维持着在星系理事会中的席位。
texts.en: Our term as the Custodians of the Galactic Community has reached its end. The Custodianship has been terminated and our special powers rescinded, although we have retained our seat on the Galactic Council.

texts.zh: 随着他们的任期结束，[former_custodians.GetName]放弃了他们作为星海共同体监管人的地位。他们的特殊权力也废除了，当然他们依然还维持着在星系理事会中的席位。
texts.en: With their term at an end, the [former_custodians.GetName] has given up their status as the Custodians of the Galactic Community. Their special powers have been rescinded, and they are now considered a regular member of the Galactic Council.

label.zh: 这样就好。
label.en: So be it.

title.zh: 泛星系防卫军暂停行动

texts.zh: 由于星海监管人的职位现在空缺，泛星系防卫军设立了一个独立的指挥架构。他们依然致力于保护星海共同体，泛星系防卫军的指挥高层宣誓将继续巡逻成员国的恒星系。
texts.en: With the office of the Galactic Custodian now vacant, the Galactic Defense Force has established an independent command structure. They remain dedicated towards the protection of the Community, and GDF High Command has vowed to maintain their patrols of member systems.

label.zh: 他们的警觉令人肃然起敬。
label.en: Their vigilance is commendable.

texts.zh: 我们终于摆脱了吃力不讨好的监管人职位！让其他随便什么人去担心这帮忘恩负义的家伙们的未来吧。
texts.en: Finally we are rid of the thankless and futile Custodianship! Let someone else worry about the future of this ungrateful galaxy.

texts.zh: [former_custodians.GetName]提前结束了他们在星海共同体中的监管人任期。似乎他们并不愿意承担监管人的责任。
texts.en: The [former_custodians.GetName] has prematurely ended their term as Custodians of the Galactic Community. It seems the responsibilities of the Custodianship weren't to their liking.

label.zh: 我们已经尽我们所能了。
label.en: We have done our part.

texts.en: The ungrateful fools in the Galactic Senate have voted to terminate our Custodianship! We have been stripped of all Community powers that were associated with the office.

texts.zh: 在通过突然且充满羞辱的方式剥夺了他们的监管权之后，星海参议院多数投票统一立即将[From.GetName]从星海监管人职位移除。他们被剥夺了星海共同体赋予的特殊权力。

label.zh: 这简直骇人听闻！
label.en: This is an outrage!

title.zh: 泛星系防卫军向监管人报告

texts.zh: 由于我们已经肩负了星海监管人的职责，泛星系防卫军现在被纳入我们的指挥架构。他们等待我们在未来的进一步指示。
texts.en: As we have assumed the office of the Galactic Custodian, the Galactic Defense Force has been folded into our command structure. They will now look to us for future orders.

label.zh: 很好。
label.en: Very good.

tooltips.zh: 所有泛星系防卫军下辖的舰队现在受我们指挥。
tooltips.en: All GDF fleets are now under our command.

texts.zh:
参议院已经批准建立一支常设的多国联合武装部队，意在防卫星海共同体。这支“泛星系防卫军”将会从所有共同体成员国当中征募兵员，成员国要求贡献自己的一部分资源来支持舰队的建设。

泛星系防卫军现在已经处于[custodian.GetName]——现任监管人——的直接控制之下，有关人士担忧这支庞大的舰队会成为镇压反对意见的工具。然而，也有不少人对其创立拍手称快，称这支舰队“始终活跃在星系防卫的最前线”。
texts.en:
The Senate has ratified the creation of a standing multinational military force intended for the defense of the Galactic Community. This "Galactic Defense Force" will recruit its personnel from all Community members, who are also required to contribute resources towards the construction of its fleets.

With the GDF being placed under the direct command of the [custodian.GetName], the current Galactic Custodians, some fear that this potentially massive armada could be used as a tool of oppression. Others, however, applaud its creation, referring to it as "the galaxy's first line of defense."

texts.zh:
参议院已经批准建立一支常设的多国联合武装部队，意在防卫星海共同体。这支“泛星系防卫军”将会从所有共同体成员国当中征募兵员，成员国要求贡献自己的一部分资源来支持舰队的建设。

由于星系全境陷入混乱，并受到了意在消灭所有智慧生命体的势力的长期威胁，各界衷心希望泛星系防卫军能够对敌人发动打击，以维系星海共同体的边疆安全。星海监管人[custodian.GetName]将直接指挥舰队，负责领导这次行动。
texts.en:
The Senate has ratified the creation of a standing multinational military force intended for the defense of the Galactic Community. This "Galactic Defense Force" will recruit its personnel from all Community members, who are also required to contribute resources towards the construction of its fleets.

With the galaxy engulfed in turmoil and under constant threat by forces that seek to exterminate all sapient life, it is hoped that the GDF will be able to bring the fight to the enemy and secure the borders of the Community. They will be placed under the direct command of the [custodian.GetName], the Galactic Custodians.

texts.zh:
参议院已经批准建立一支常设的多国联合武装部队，意在防卫星海共同体。这支“泛星系防卫军”将会从所有共同体成员国当中征募兵员，成员国要求贡献自己的一部分资源来支持舰队的建设。

由于星系全境陷入混乱，各界衷心希望泛星系防卫军能够进一步扩编增长实力，以应对失落帝国为了征服星系全境而派遣出来的庞大舰队。星海监管人[custodian.GetName]将直接指挥舰队。
texts.en:
The Senate has ratified the creation of a standing multinational military force intended for the defense of the Galactic Community. This "Galactic Defense Force" will recruit its personnel from all Community members, who are also required to contribute resources towards the construction of its fleets.

With the galaxy engulfed by war, it is hoped that the GDF will expand to become strong enough to challenge even the vast fleets being thrown around by the Fallen Empires in their petty squabbles for galactic dominance. They will be placed under the direct command of the [custodian.GetName], the Galactic Custodians.

label.zh: 本星系将会变成一个更加安全的地方。
label.en: The galaxy will become a safer place.

label.zh: 我们各司其职。
label.en: We're doing our part.

label.zh: 随他们去吧。
label.en: Good for them.

label.zh: 这支可怜的舰队将会被歼灭，直到最后一艘舰船损失殆尽。
label.en: This pathetic fleet will be exterminated to the last ship.

label.zh: 决议解散防卫军
label.en: A resolution disbands the Defense Force

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现新任监管人的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the new Custodian appears here.

texts.zh: 依照参议院大多数的表决，泛星系防卫军被解散了。所有现役的泛星系防卫军人员将返回其母国，而防卫军的战舰将在参议院官员的密切监督下拆解，以防止这些战舰落入心有不轨之人的手中。
texts.en: By order of the Senate majority, the Galactic Defense Force has been disbanded. All serving GDF personnel have returned to their home nations, and their warships are being scuttled under the close supervision of Senate officials to prevent them from falling into the wrong hands.

label.zh: 一个不光彩的结局。
label.en: An unglamorous end.

summary.text:
# 指派星海监管人 / Galactic Custodian Appointed

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · DLC：Nemesis · 来源 Sources：`events/nemesis_custodian_events.txt:12-130`、`events/nemesis_custodian_events.txt:157-340`、`events/nemesis_custodian_events.txt:405-456`、`events/nemesis_custodian_events.txt:459-471`、`events/nemesis_custodian_events.txt:615-651`、`events/nemesis_custodian_events.txt:739-776`、`common/resolutions/01_resolutions_nemesis.txt:683-722,866-893,2149-2235,2570-2612`、`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3603-3606,4727-4731` · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

银河共同体“监管人”在理事会通过提名决议（resolution_galacticreforms_nominate_custodian，common/resolutions/01_resolutions_nemesis.txt:683-722）时指派：该决议设置监管人，发出隐藏的 custodian.1，后者给监管人加上 gal_custodian 修正，并向每个共同体成员发出 custodian.2“指派星海监管人”（events/nemesis_custodian_events.txt:52-72）。

The Galactic Community custodian is appointed when the council passes the nomination resolution (resolution_galacticreforms_nominate_custodian, common/resolutions/01_resolutions_nemesis.txt:683-722): it sets the custodian and fires hidden custodian.1, which adds the gal_custodian modifier and sends every community member custodian.2 "Galactic Custodian Appointed" (events/nemesis_custodian_events.txt:52-72).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

这是一个循环：任命（custodian.2，对监管人与其他成员文字与选项不同，events/nemesis_custodian_events.txt:76-120）→ 任期到期 / 提前终止 / 除名 / 被毁灭，四种结束方式互斥。另有“泛星系防卫军”（GDF）支线：监管人通过决议建立防卫军（custodian.30，对监管人、成员、非成员、杀戮型国家各有选项）；监管人结束时若防卫军已启用，隐藏的 custodian.31 创建独立的 GDF 国家，10天后向玩家发出 custodian.32；新监管人上任时（防卫军仍启用）10天后 custodian.35 让独立 GDF 并入新监管人并注销该国家；决议解散防卫军则发出 custodian.40。

A cycle: appointment (custodian.2, with different text and options for the custodian and other members, events/nemesis_custodian_events.txt:76-120) -> the term expires, is ended early, is unseated, or the custodian is destroyed; the four endings are exclusive. A side branch is the Galactic Defense Force (GDF): the custodian passes the resolution (custodian.30, with options for the custodian, members, non-members and homicidal empires); if the GDF is active when the custodianship ends hidden custodian.31 creates an independent GDF country and 10 days later sends custodian.32 to players; when a new custodian takes office (GDF still active) custodian.35 follows 10 days later, merging the independent GDF into the new custodian and destroying that country; the disband resolution sends custodian.40.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

四种结束方式：到期（custodian.11，on_custodian_term_ends）；提前终止（custodian.15，仅 Nemesis 或银河捍卫者飞升天赋的监管人可提案，同时取消提名决议）；被除名（custodian.17）；国家被毁（custodian.101，非 AI 玩家看到）。15 会隐藏给“确实完成了使命的银河捍卫者”。

Four endings: expiry (custodian.11, on_custodian_term_ends); early end (custodian.15, proposable only with Nemesis or the Defender of the Galaxy perk, and cancels the nomination resolution); unseating (custodian.17); the country is destroyed (custodian.101, shown to non-AI players). 15 is hidden when the ex-custodian is a Defender of the Galaxy who did the job.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

各窗口按“是否是本人”（is_same_value = from）给出不同正文与选项。防卫军支线需要 Nemesis 或银河捍卫者（游牧）飞升天赋。

Windows differ by whether the viewer is the custodian himself (is_same_value = from). The Defense Force branch needs Nemesis or the nomadic Defender of the Galaxy perk.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已对照游戏文件核对入口、触发、选项与结果；行号均为游戏文件的真实行号。
  Entry, trigger, options and outcomes were checked against the game files; line numbers are real game-file lines.
- 合并说明：event-custodian-14/16/100/30/40 原为同一循环的碎片（各自只有结束事件或 GDF 通知），已并入本故事；custodian.499 是永不触发的测试事件。
  Merge note: event-custodian-14/16/100/30/40 were fragments of the same cycle (a single ending event or GDF notice each) and are now part of this story; custodian.499 is a test event that never fires.
